title: The Night the Sky Said Hello
subtitle: A very rainy night. Four very strange arrivals. One very soggy first meeting.

pages.alt: Four-panel comic page: a storm over a hidden valley, Barsaat splashes into being, studies a puddle reflection, then notices an orange spark falling from the clouds.

panels.caption: On the wettest night in a sky's-eye view...
One strange drop took the express puddle.

dialogue.speaker: Barsaat
dialogue.text: Whoa. I just puddled into existence!

panels.caption: A second surprise came in hot.

pages.alt: Four-panel comic page: Agni lands in a puddle with a puff of steam, meets Barsaat, shares a tiny tail-glow, and they discover a glowing path uphill.

panels.caption: The spark landed with one very small splash.

dialogue.speaker: Agni
dialogue.text: I meant to make a soft landing!

dialogue.speaker: Agni
dialogue.text: Agni. I bring the heat, not the humidity.

dialogue.speaker: Agni
dialogue.text: Let's follow it. I'm fired up for this idea!

pages.alt: Four-panel comic page: a golden glow reveals Noor floating down through the rain, greeting Barsaat and Agni, then guiding them toward a hill.

panels.caption: A golden glow drifted out of the storm.

dialogue.speaker: Noor
dialogue.text: Hi! I'm Noor. I was moth-ivated to come say hello.

panels.caption: Noor's glow revealed a path up the hill.

pages.alt: Four-panel comic page: the hillside rumbles, Aarav emerges from a mossy boulder, stops a rolling rock, and meets the other three creatures.

panels.caption: Up the hill: rumble, grumble, tumble!

dialogue.speaker: Barsaat
dialogue.text: Was that thunder—or a very round hello?

dialogue.speaker: Aarav
dialogue.text: I didn't roll in. The hill rolled me here.

panels.caption: Four strangers. One very soggy introduction.

pages.alt: Four-panel comic page: a glowing rain-orb rolls toward the stream, Barsaat redirects the water, Noor and Agni reveal a safe route, and Aarav braces a rock.

panels.caption: A giant glow-drop broke loose toward the stream!
Barsaat curled his tail to guide the rushing water.
Noor lit the way; Agni added a gentle glow.
Four new friends. One mighty splash.

pages.alt: Four-panel comic page: the storm orb floats safely into the clouds, the four friends celebrate, and they walk together toward a new dawn.

panels.caption: Together, they sent the glow-drop safely back to the clouds.

dialogue.speaker: Noor
dialogue.text: A bright idea from a dark night.

dialogue.speaker: Barsaat
dialogue.text: That pun really weighs a lot.

panels.caption: The storm stopped. Their story had only begun.
